plugin.name: x11-windows
plugin._long: X11 windows where and as their programs ask: games on the screen they ask for, borderless full screen made full screen, and no moves the pointer did not start.

option.name: games
option._short: Games get the screen they ask for
option._long: A full-screen X11 window goes to the screen it asked for rather than the focused one, and a window without a frame that asks to cover a whole screen (a game's "borderless full screen") is made full screen there instead of being fitted between the menu bar and the dock.

option.name: moves_need_button
option._long: An X11 window may ask to be moved or resized only while a mouse button or a finger is down, as when its own title bar is dragged; otherwise Wayfire would hold it to the pointer until the next click.
